page.content:
2020 film of a jazz teacher stuck between Earth and the Great Before.

How Soul connects

  • Creator: Pete Docter — Pete Docter directed Soul.
  • Artist: Joe Gardner — Soul is Joe Gardner's story between jazz and the Great Before.
  • Topic: Pixar — Soul is a Pixar feature.

What is Soul?

Soul follows Joe Gardner, a middle-school band teacher who almost dies on the way to a gig and has to relearn why a life is worth the body it is in.

Key threads lead to Pete Docter, Joe Gardner and Pixar.
